description: This PHP source file defines the 'Pool' class in the GuzzleHttp namespace, which manages concurrent HTTP request sending using a request pool. It handles request iteration, concurrency, and callback management.

classes.name: Pool
classes.description: A class for managing a pool of concurrent HTTP requests with configurable concurrency, options, and callbacks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Pool object with a client, requests (or functions), and configuration options.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when all requests in the pool complete.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Executes multiple requests concurrently and returns an array of responses or exceptions, maintaining request order.
